title: Protein Variant Structure Context
description: Locate an exact protein substitution in an experimental RCSB structure and review nearby protein residues and coordinate hetero groups with author numbering.

tools.name: variant_structure_preflight
tools.description: Resolve an exact PDB author chain and one-letter protein substitution, then preview heavy-atom contacts without writing analysis outputs.

pdb_id.description: Four-character RCSB PDB identifier such as 6OIM.

chain.description: Exact author chain identifier such as A.

variant.description: One-letter protein substitution such as G12C.

tools.name: variant_structure_collect
tools.description: Persist an approved experimental variant-site contact review with contact, ligand, report, manifest, summary, and viewer outputs.
